about_the_game:
Angie is a sweet, cheerful and creative girl who enjoys all the cute, shiny and colorful things. And magical girls too! Angie has no one to share her passions with, though, so she spends her days amongst people’s hostility and indifference.

Everything changes when one day she awakens in a mysterious forest. There, Angie meets a talking cat who tells her that she’s been chosen by the Eternal Smile to embark on a very special adventure and that, if she wants, she can become a magical girl. Angie doesn’t understand what is going on, but, can you guess what she’s about to do?

GAME FEATURES

  • Delve into the magic lands of Lamentia, make the fear, sadness and hate that torment its folks vanish, and fulfil the prophecy of the legendary magical girl. 

  • Unlock the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile and turn it into different weapons and tools to overcome all the challenges in your adventure!

  • Explore the farthest spots in this mysterious world, solve the conundrums hidden in the depths of Lamentia's castles and uncover hidden secrets using magic spells.

  • Collect all the stickers from your culinary album and prepare delicious dishes. Cook them with love and make them even more nutritious!

  • Fulfil the prophecy your way by finding and equipping all the different charms in the Wand of the Eternal Smile.

short_description: Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!
